  "chapter": 6,
  "observed_printed_unit_count": 7,
  "printed_units": [
    {
      "verse": 1,
      "source_text": "ወኮነ፡ አመ፡ በዝኁ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ በእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ተወልደ፡ ሎሙ፡ አዋልድ፡ ሠናያት፡ ወመልካማት፡",
      "source_pages": [12],
      "critical_signs": [],
      "uncertainties": []
    },
    {
      "verse": 2,
      "source_text": "ወርእዮ፡ ⟦?⟧ሩቤ፡ መላእክት፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወፈተውወን፡ ወይቤሉ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ ንዑ፡ ንኅረይ፡ ለነ፡ አንስተ፡ እምውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወንውለድ፡ ለነ፡ ውሉደ።",
      "source_pages": [12],
      "critical_signs": [],
      "uncertainties": [
        "Second word: its initial glyph is not securely distinguishable in the supplied photograph."
      ]
    },
    {
      "verse": 3,
      "source_text": "ወይቤሎሙ፡ ሰምያዛ፡ እንዘ፡ ውእቱ፡ መስፍኖሙ፡ እፈርህ፡ ⟦?⟧እ፡ ኢትፈቅዱ፡ ይትገበር፡ ዝንቱ፡ ግብር፡ ወእከውን፡ አነ፡ ባሕቲትየ፡ ፈዳየ፡ ዘኀጢአት፡ ዓቢይ።",
      "source_pages": [12],
      "critical_signs": [],
      "uncertainties": [
        "First word on the line beginning immediately after እፈርህ፡: initial glyph unresolved."
      ]
    },
    {
      "verse": 4,
      "source_text": "ወአውሥኡ፡ ኵሎ፡ ⟦?⟧⟦?⟧⟦?⟧፡ ወይቤሉ፡ መሐላ፡ ንምሐል፡ ኵልነ፡ ወንትጋባእ፡ ኵልነ፡ በበይናቲነ፡ ከመ፡ ኢንገብር፡ በዝንቱ፡ ምክረ፡ ወን⟦?⟧⟦?⟧ር፡ *በዝንቱ፡ [ምክረ፡] ግብር።",
      "source_pages": [12],
      "critical_signs": ["*", "[", "]"],
      "uncertainties": [
        "Word between ኵሎ፡ and ወይቤሉ፡: the three apparent glyph positions are unresolved; their segmentation is also uncertain.",
        "Word immediately before *በዝንቱ፡: the two medial glyphs following ወን are unresolved."
      ]
    },
    {
      "verse": 5,
      "source_text": "አሜሃ፡ መሐሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ⟦?⟧በ፡ ወአውገዙ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ በ⟦?⟧፡",
      "source_pages": [12],
      "critical_signs": [],
      "uncertainties": [
        "Word following ኵሎሙ፡: initial glyph unresolved.",
        "Final word: apparent glyph following በ is unresolved; the boundary between that glyph and the separator is not secure."
      ]
    },
    {
      "verse": 6,
      "source_text": "ወኮኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ *ክልኤ፡ ምእት፡ †ወወረዱ፡ ውስተ፡ አርዲስ፡ *በዕለተ፡ ያሬድ፡ በዲበ፡ እርሞን፡ ወጸው⟦?⟧፡ *ስም፡ እርሞን፡ እስመ፡ መሐሉ፡ በ፡ ወአውገዙ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ።",
      "source_pages": [12, 14],
      "critical_signs": ["*", "†", "*", "*"],
      "uncertainties": [
        "First word of the continuation on printed page 14: final glyph unresolved.",
        "Star placement immediately before ስም፡ on printed page 14 is not fully secure."
      ]
    },
    {
      "verse": 7,
      "source_text": "ወዝንቱ፡ እስማቲሆሙ፡ ለመላእክቲሆሙ፡ ሰምያዛ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ውእቱ፡ መስፍኖሙ፡ *አርስተ⟦?⟧ማን፡ ኮከቤኤል፡ ጠምኤል፡ ራምኤል፡ ዳንኤል፡ እዜቄኤል፡ ባራ⟦?⟧ኤል፡ አሣኤል፡ አርማሮስ፡ በጠ⟦?⟧ኤል፡ አናንኤል፡ ዘቄኤል፡ ሳም⟦?⟧ኤል፡ ⟦?⟧ታርኤል፡ ⟦?⟧ርኤል፡ የምያኤል፡ †እራዝያል፡† እሉ፡ እሙንቱ፡ *ሀለቃት፡ ዓሥርት፡ ዘእሙው።",
      "source_pages": [14],
      "critical_signs": ["*", "†", "†", "*"],
      "uncertainties": [
        "Starred name following መስፍኖሙ፡: glyph between ተ and ማ unresolved.",
        "Name following እዜቄኤል፡: glyph following ባራ unresolved.",
        "First name on the line beginning በጠ: third glyph unresolved.",
        "Name following ዘቄኤል፡: medial glyph following ሳም unresolved; segmentation there is not fully secure.",
        "Name immediately before the name ending ርኤል፡: initial glyph unresolved.",
        "Name immediately before የምያኤል፡: initial glyph unresolved."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "last_unit_unnumbered_coda_source": "እሉ፡ እሙንቱ፡ *ሀለቃት፡ ዓሥርት፡ ዘእሙው።",

  "limits": "Direct visual reading of the supplied main-body photographs only. source_pages uses printed pagination: 12 and 14, corresponding to pdf50.png and pdf52.png.
